lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr2Ge12Bi2 (ZrGe6Bi) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies a close-packed-like local arrangement for both Bi and Zr centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors, while Ge centers show 9 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 9-vertex Ge polyhedra, with additional corner- and face-sharing between Bi and Ge polyhedra.
